newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse newcomer shares surge.
newsitem.headline: German bourse newcomer shares surge.

text.p: Shares in Germany's BHW Holding AG surged on Wednesday amid what dealers said were unusually high volumes for the newly issued stock.

The savings, finance and insurance company's shares rose nearly four percent to 29.15 marks by 1100 GMT, 3.15 marks above their issue price of 26 marks and 1.15 marks above the opening level at their bourse debut on Monday of 28 marks.
The 70-share MDAX mid-cap index, which BHW wants to join, was up 0.43 percent at 3,556.99.
A trading volume of some 1.6 million shares put BHW in second place on the market in terms of turnover.
Dealers said the gains were powered by strong buy interest from institutional investors, particularly German buyers.
BHW, Germany's second largest building financing firm, launched itself on the bourse on Monday after a share offer that it said was 14.5 times oversubscribed.
Of the total flotation volume of 1.4 billion marks, around 80 percent was placed in Germany and 20 percent abroad.
